rows.read_by: claude-opus-5 reading the page's OWN BITMAP, extracted from the PDF with pdfplumber (`page.images[0]['stream'].get_data()`), opened with PIL and rotated 90 degrees anticlockwise to upright -- this table is printed PORTRAIT inside a page carrying /Rotate 270. No renderer and NO RECOGNITION was used: the committed OCR TSV for this edition was not consulted for any figure here, and the clean re-OCR installed for FY2019 this week was used for nothing at all, not even geometry. FY2019 carries NO text layer on any of its 206 pages -- pdfplumber.extract_words() returns 0 words on pages 40 and 41, each of which holds one 1275x1651 bitmap at 150 dpi. The pages are portrait, one table, large type, and legible at 2x without cropping; three horizontal bands per page were read at 2x to check every digit a second time.
rows.proof: `TOWN OF LUNENBURG / SPECIAL REVENUE FUNDS / FISCAL YEAR ENDING 6/30/19`, PDF page 40 of the FY2019 annual town report. THE PAGE PRINTS ITS OWN FOLIO AS `38`, two behind the PDF page, and that is the single most important fact about this file. THE PRINTED COLUMN HEADER, VERBATIM AND IN ORDER (rule 13b.4): `PROGRAM NAME` | `FORWARD 7/1/2018` | `TOTAL RECEIPTS` | `TOTAL DISBURSEMENTS` | `BALANCE FWD 7/1/2019`. The header block is reprinted at the top of every page of the run. 28 fund rows. THIS PAGE PRINTS NO TOTAL OF ITS OWN. It is page 4 of a FIVE-page table running PDF 37 to 41, and the only total the table prints is the `GRAND TOTAL` row at the foot of PDF page 41, which foots all five pages: `$3,972,219.13` | `$6,391,333.14` | `$5,787,228.78` | `$4,576,323.49`. Those four figures are NOT declared as `kind=total` in this file, because this file holds two of the five pages and declaring them here would report the three pages NOT YET TRANSCRIBED as a failure of this reading. When PDF pages 37, 38 and 39 are transcribed into this same group, the four `total` rows belong on page 41 and the group closes. WHAT IS ESTABLISHED MEANWHILE, and it is less than a printed total. (1) EVERY ONE OF THE 28 ROWS closes on the identity the table states about itself -- forward plus receipts less disbursements is the balance carried -- recomputed at the moment of transcription, zero failures. THAT IDENTITY IS NOT DECLARED AS A `check` ROW AND THE REASON IS A LIMIT OF THE VERIFIER, NOT OF THE PAGE: `verify_page_reads.py` parses `row_identity` as either all-plus (`a,b,c=d`) or minus-after-the-first (`a-b-c=d`), and `forward + receipts - disbursements = carried` is MIXED and cannot be written in either. FY2011's 159 rows and FY2013's 126 rows are in exactly this position and left it undeclared for the same reason. Declaring a wrong form and attesting the rows that then failed would attest our own limitation as the town's error. (2) The whole five-page run ties to the printed GRAND TOTAL in all four columns to the cent, 143 rows, diff 0.00 -- but that was computed against `sources/data/special-revenue-read.csv` for pages 37-39, which is a DERIVED file and not this reading, and rule 13 forbids quoting it as though it were the page. It is recorded as corroboration, not as the proof. THE RENUMBERING THIS FILE EXISTS TO FIX. `special-revenue-read.csv` numbers FY2019 by the PRINTED FOLIO while all fifteen other years carry the PDF page, so its rows for `page 38` are this page and its rows for `page 39` are PDF page 41. Every one of the 28 rows below was read independently off the bitmap and matches those rows digit for digit, which is what identifies the content rather than the label. The consequence in the tracker was two FALSE claims and two false absences: `annual-report-pages.csv` recorded PDF 35 and 36 -- which are APPROPRIATIONS pages -- as proven by `special-revenue-read`, and PDF 40 and 41 as unproven. SIGNS ARE THE DOCUMENT'S. Figures printed in PARENTHESES, in red, are recorded negative: C.O.A./M.A.R.T. Revolving opens at ($13,795.55) and closes at ($5,942.10), FY19 Earmark - Senior Center closes at ($25,000.00), Green Communities Grant at ($28,309.84). A BLANK CELL IS NOT A ZERO: 12 rows print nothing in receipts and 13 print nothing in disbursements, and those are recorded as no value, while a cell printing `$0.00` is recorded as 0.00. ROWS ARE KEYED BY PRINTED POSITION, never by name -- `fund_number` is the PDF page and the row's ordinal down it. `fund_name` carries the printed section heading then the printed program name. THE SECTION OF THE FIRST SEVEN ROWS WAS READ, NOT INFERRED: PDF page 39 ends with the heading `COUNCIL ON AGING` printed with no rows under it, and that page's folio is `37` -- a sixth independent corroboration of folio = PDF - 2. `LIBRARY`, `CEMETERIES` and `UNCLASSIFIED` are printed on this page. WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH, and CLAUDE.md rule 11 is the whole of it: these are funds the general-fund appropriation schedule does not show. Nothing here says which of them paid for a post that also appears in the appropriation.

rows.proof: `TOWN OF LUNENBURG / SPECIAL REVENUE FUNDS / FISCAL YEAR ENDING 6/30/19`, PDF page 41 of the FY2019 annual town report. THE PAGE PRINTS ITS OWN FOLIO AS `39`, two behind the PDF page. THE PRINTED COLUMN HEADER, VERBATIM AND IN ORDER: `PROGRAM NAME` | `FORWARD 7/1/2018` | `TOTAL RECEIPTS` | `TOTAL DISBURSEMENTS` | `BALANCE FWD 7/1/2019`. 29 fund rows and then the table's only total. THE PRINTED `GRAND TOTAL` ROW, VERBATIM: `$3,972,219.13` | `$6,391,333.14` | `$5,787,228.78` | `$4,576,323.49`. IT FOOTS ALL FIVE PAGES OF THE TABLE (PDF 37-41), NOT THIS ONE, so it is NOT written here as `kind=total`: this file and its p40 sibling hold two of the five pages, and declaring it would make the three pages not yet transcribed read as a failure of this reading. It belongs on this page the moment PDF 37, 38 and 39 join this group. SEE THE `proof` ON `fy2019-p40-special-revenue.csv` FOR THE FULL STATEMENT OF WHAT IS AND IS NOT ESTABLISHED. TWO INDEPENDENT PRINTINGS AGREE WITH THAT GRAND TOTAL AND NEITHER IS OURS. Its FORWARD figure, $3,972,219.13, is the balance the FY2018 report's own grand total carries forward; its BALANCE FWD figure, $4,576,323.49, is the forward the FY2020 report's grand total opens on. Both are in `sources/data/special-revenue-printed-totals.csv`, read off those two documents. That chains this page's total to two other editions and is the strongest thing available until the run is whole. EVERY ONE OF THE 29 ROWS closes on forward plus receipts less disbursements equals the balance carried, recomputed at transcription, zero failures; the identity is NOT declared, because the verifier cannot express a mixed-sign one. NEITHER THIS PAGE NOR PAGE 40 IS A REPRINT. The question is live -- FY2016's p32 is an un-headed duplicate reprint whose 84 figures all appear elsewhere -- and it is settled here by the arithmetic rather than by the look of the page: across the five-page run the 143 rows foot to the printed GRAND TOTAL in all four columns with a difference of 0.00, and this page alone contributes $616,133.25 of forward, $640,147.94 of receipts, $488,622.49 of disbursements and $767,658.70 of balance carried. Counting either page twice, or dropping either, breaks all four. NO FUND NAME IS REPEATED anywhere in the 143 rows, so no name collision can have merged two rows into one. NO SECTION HEADING IS PRINTED ON THIS PAGE. Every row continues the `UNCLASSIFIED` section whose heading is printed on PDF page 40; the section is carried forward, which is what the document does, and is recorded as such rather than left blank. SIGNS ARE THE DOCUMENT'S: Municipal Energy Technical Assistance Grant prints ($5.00) forward and ($5.00) disbursed and closes at $0.00 -- a NEGATIVE DISBURSEMENT, which is the document's and not a transcription error, and it is what makes that row's identity close. Accessible Amenities Grant closes at ($7,500.00). A BLANK CELL IS NOT A ZERO: 17 rows print nothing in receipts and 19 print nothing in disbursements.

rows.proof: `CAPITAL PROJECT FUNDS FY 2019`, PDF page 42 of the FY2019 annual town report (printed folio 40), a LANDSCAPE page, mediaBox 792x612 with /Rotate 270. READ, NOT RECOGNISED: pdfplumber returns 0 words on this page and on every one of the 38 financial pages of this report, and the committed OCR TSV for this report is a CLIPPED RENDER losing the top 22.73% of every page -- which is why `annual-report-pages.csv` records this page's heading as `$200.00 fwd` rather than as the title above. COLUMNS NAMED FROM THE PRINTED HEADER, NOT INFERRED (rule 13b.4): ART #/YR, PURPOSE, APPROPRIATED FORWARD, EXPENDED/ENCUMBERED/TRANSFERRED, BALANCE. THREE ASSERTIONS, EXACT, NO TOLERANCE, against the page's own printed `Grand Total` row: appropriated_forward 8,493,845.14, expended_encumbered_transferred 2,161,866.13, balance 6,331,979.01. All three close over 50 transcribed lines. THE PER-ROW IDENTITY appropriated_forward - expended_encumbered_transferred = balance WAS CHECKED BY HAND ON EVERY LINE AND IS NOT DECLARED HERE, because two lines the page prints cannot be written in this file's grammar and declaring it would make the page read as a failure. 48 of 50 close exactly. The two: (a) `Development of Cemeteries` IS PRINTED ON TWO LINES -- an unlabelled `$20,000.00` in APPROPRIATED FORWARD above the labelled row, and `($798.41) fwd` on it -- and the identity closes only when both are taken together: 20,000.00 - 798.41 - 20,349.92 = (1,148.33), the balance the page prints. That is the same `a fwd line is a line of the column` shape FY2021 records, and the page's own Grand Total includes both lines, which is what proves the pairing rather than our assuming it. The two lines are transcribed separately here, under the names above, so nothing is invented. (b) `(2) Utility Pickups - DPW` prints 90,614.00 appropriated and 90,614.00 expended and LEAVES THE BALANCE CELL BLANK. The blank is the document's; 0.00 is not printed and is not recorded. NEGATIVES ARE PRINTED IN PARENTHESES and are recorded as negative numbers: ($798.41), ($1,148.33) and ($46.59). The page's own legend reads `fwd - forward from FY 18 / ATM - Annual Town Meeting / STM - Special Town Meeting`.
